metaDescription: Order vibrant custom rainbow luggage accessories for your team. Perfect for events and giveaways. Shop bulk at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rainbow-colored luggage accessories bring a bold, inclusive look to any corporate giveaway or event. Whether you need custom luggage tags for a pride celebration or branded passport holders that stand out in a crowd, the rainbow finish adds instant visibility. These accessories work well with screen printing or debossing to display your logo clearly. Bulk orders are common for conference swag bags and employee welcome kits.
